mapper.select: select * from rag_tasks where document_id = #{documentId} order by created_at desc limit 1

select count(1) from rag_tasks t left join documents d on d.id = t.document_id left join knowledge_bases kb on kb.id = coalesce(t.knowledge_base_id, d.knowledge_base_id) where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and kb.id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and (#{type} is null or t.type = #{type}) and (#{status} is null or t.status = #{status}) and ( #{keyword} = '' or lower(t.type) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(t.status) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(d.file_name, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(kb.name, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') )

select t.*, kb.name as knowledge_base_name, d.file_name as document_file_name from rag_tasks t left join documents d on d.id = t.document_id left join knowledge_bases kb on kb.id = coalesce(t.knowledge_base_id, d.knowledge_base_id) where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and kb.id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and (#{type} is null or t.type = #{type}) and (#{status} is null or t.status = #{status}) and ( #{keyword} = '' or lower(t.type) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(t.status) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(d.file_name, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(kb.name, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') ) order by t.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(1) as total, coalesce(sum(case when t.status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending, coalesce(sum(case when t.status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as running, coalesce(sum(case when t.status = 'SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as succeeded, coalesce(sum(case when t.status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failed, coalesce(sum(case when t.status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelled, coalesce(sum(case when t.cancel_requested = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancel_requested, coalesce(sum(case when t.type = 'INGEST_DOCUMENT' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as ingest_document, coalesce(sum(case when t.type = 'REBUILD_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_INDEX' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rebuild_knowledge_base_index, cast(coalesce(round(avg(case when t.started_at is not null and t.finished_at is not null then timestampdiff(microsecond, t.started_at, t.finished_at) / 1000 else null end)), 0) as signed) as average_duration_ms, cast(coalesce(max(case when t.started_at is not null and t.finished_at is not null then timestampdiff(microsecond, t.started_at, t.finished_at) / 1000 else null end), 0) as signed) as max_duration_ms from rag_tasks t left join documents d on d.id = t.document_id left join knowledge_bases kb on kb.id = coalesce(t.knowledge_base_id, d.knowledge_base_id) where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and kb.id = #{knowledgeBaseId}
